name: Dagger
description: The dagger light — a long, narrow outline with a point at each end.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @shape(points: 200; x: 0.34 * cos(t)^3; y: sin(t); scale: 0.98; frame: 11); clip-path: @shape(points: 200; x: 0.34 * cos(t)^3; y: sin(t); scale: 0.98; frame: 11); -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
